info.name: ITAS Tax Audit System - Complete Enterprise API Collection (406 Endpoints + E2E Test Suite)
info.description: Complete, importable Postman Collection v2.1 for the Ethiopian Ministry of Revenues (MOR) Integrated Tax Audit System (ITAS). Covers all 42 Spring Boot REST Controllers (406 API endpoints) plus a 41-step automated End-to-End Positive, Negative, Security & Workflow Test Suite.

item.name: 00. End-to-End Automated Test Suite (Positive, Negative, Security & Workflows)
item.description: Executable end-to-end test suite with automated assertions covering Authentication, Annual Planning, Case Management, JAC Committee, Desk Audit, Comprehensive Audit, Transfer Pricing, Issue Audit, and Quality Assurance.
